behavioralReview.baseline: The old 764d class, original unique action/predicate and original dump execute in the same harness. The first diagnostic-availability assertion follows actual original scroll/rectangle, one exact left press/release pair, original 60,000ms hydration argument and false-then-true predicate results. Missing exports/imports/helpers, extraction and setup failure do not qualify.
behavioralReview.harnessBoundary: The renderer evaluates original Runtime.evaluate strings in a separate VM realm with a finite DOM/store/event fixture. Only the subsequent hydration wait is intercepted to evaluate its original predicate once and retain its exact original timeout argument. The initial click readiness uses actual original waitFor. No Electron, native process, main(), real CDP network or child executor is run.
